description: VAL-21 and EXP-39 expectations shared by the AST tests of every package and by scripts/check-generated-native-calls.mjs. Every host renders the templates with the assign entries order, same, other and items: order and same are one host object of the order class, other is a second object of that class and items is the list [1]. Every host registers describe, mutate and pick as host functions, Order::describe as a logical class function, and describe as a public method of the order class. describe returns the description of its arguments, mutate changes its list and map arguments and returns null, and pick returns its argument. A native object has no order (compare.tpl) and no JSON text, also inside a list or a map (json.tpl, FUN-26).
